title: ARGD research materials for requirement-linked neighboring-scenario validation of vulnerability patches
description: Public companion materials S1 to S7 for ARGD: Requirement-Linked Neighboring-Scenario Validation for Vulnerability Patches, by Yi Lv and Cheng Wang. The archive contains source-catalog metadata, the four-row VUL4J-32 repair-coverage matrix, archived execution evidence, preserved evaluator records and an offline audit program, contextual observations and screening summaries, figure inputs and plotting code, and reproduction identities. Public copies normalize historical machine-local path strings and omit two internal review documents. Numerical results, testcase outcomes, assertions and Java/fixture sources are preserved. PUBLICATION_PROVENANCE.md and the package manifests document these transformations and the original evidence boundaries. CC BY 4.0 covers the author-created matrix and new repository documentation. Other archived materials retain their applicable rights and the supplied Apache and MIT notices.
